subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should soft steer terminate the current model turn and start a context-preserving follow-up, or guarantee transparent continuation of the same logical run after partial output and tool state are checkpointed?
rationale: These options create materially different transcript, cancellation, tool-side-effect, backend, and user-experience contracts, so permanent behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Abort and preserve context
options.body: End the current model turn cleanly, persist usable partial output, and immediately start a new turn containing the steering message.

options.title: Resume the same run
options.body: Checkpoint and resume the same logical run across generation and tool execution, accepting substantially broader runtime complexity.

options.title: Keep boundary steering
options.body: Limit steer to documented safe model or tool boundaries and retain immediate interruption as a separate explicit abort action.

recommendation.title: Abort and preserve context
recommendation.body: End the current model turn cleanly, persist usable partial output, and immediately start a new turn containing the steering message.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and replacement work are closest to the active-run lifecycle and non-streaming steering boundary.
